limitations: Targets are prompts, not proof that the participant fixated them.
Eye-validity thresholds are experimental heuristics, not clinical cutoffs.
Possible blinks are short bounded EAR events, not a validated blink classifier.
Head pose is an unvalidated diagnostic approximation.
Separability metrics are descriptive and are not classification accuracy.
This technical run is not clinical validation.

process_cpu.semantics: Process user+system CPU time divided by measured wall time. One-core basis may exceed 100%; total-capacity basis divides by logical CPU count.
